_comment: The canonical schema digest of schema.graphql in this revision, pinned so a
change to the SDL cannot land silently. Every go_api_routing_state row is
keyed by this value: when it moves, EVERY existing row becomes unreachable
and both planes fall back to Python without erroring. That happened on
2026-09-01 and went unnoticed for six days.
ci/check_go_api_routing_digest.py fails when this value does not match the
digest computed from schema.graphql, and again when the value is not
recorded in the Schema-digest history table of
moving the SDL requires updating this pin AND writing down what it breaks,
